classificationCalibrations.reason: Main is a direct retrieval/application of the taught local-quantity×width construction, unit tracking and unequal-width diagnostic on new battery data; new context does not make the evidence structurally fresh.
Main supplies the partition, tags and function values and asks the learner to execute the already taught width/tag/sum/mesh routine; this is retrieval/application on new data.

Main applies the three structural laws taught immediately before it—additivity, orientation and linearity—to new supplied integral values; the numerical surface is new but the decision structure is retrieval.
Main directly applies the taught signed-total, absolute-magnitude and average-value distinctions to a new piecewise rate; this is retrieval/application rather than new conceptual evidence.

Main directly applies the taught FTC-plus-chain moving-endpoint rule to a new endpoint and integrand. The lack of an elementary antiderivative blocks an irrelevant detour but does not change the taught decision structure.
